class_definition.datable_from_frozen_field: a frozen date field at the top level states a date
class_definition.datable_only_from_non_frozen_field: no frozen field states a date, but another payload field does
class_definition.not_a_json_object: the member is not a JSON object (csv/md/jsonl/array)
class_definition.undatable: the payload states no date anywhere the scan looks (depth <= 2)
class_definition.unreadable_member: the member is missing on disk or does not parse

method_limits: the population is E480's no_date_in_name rows; a family that gained or lost members since then is not rescanned
the scan reads the payload to depth 2 below the top level, so a date buried in a per-row list entry is not a witness (it would date a row, not the file)
a compact YYYYMMDD date in the name is counted but never promoted to a class: this face measures the payload, and the name census is published beside it
the family span comes from ISO dates in sibling *names*, not from sibling payloads; a family whose names are all undated has no span and its members read as no_span
datable says the file can be placed in time, not that it should be kept (E477/E479 own the retention decision)

span_definition.in_span: the payload date lies within [min, max] of the dates the family's member names state, in either spelling (ISO or compact YYYYMMDD)
span_definition.no_span: no member of that family states a date in its name: unmeasurable
span_definition.outside_span: the payload date lies outside that span
